name: Blood Constructor adds 1 sec of Animated Blood per Thirst stack (#2042)
contract: Blood Constructor 561196's tooltip is "Increases the duration of Animated Blood by $/1000;s1 sec per stack of Thirst." Its single effect is aura 107 with MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) and BasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = +1000, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 64, 0) = word 1 bit 6 = Sated 532125 and the helper "Thirst Val/Kal Cast/Anim Blood" 300796. 300796 is the intended target: its effect 0 is itself aura 107 with MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), amount 0, over EffectSpellClassMask (1, 0, 0) = the three Animated Blood records 573299, 573356 and 573357, so the talent raises that inner per-stack duration from 0 to 1000 ms. No Spell.dbc row references 300796 in any field and no acquisition route reaches it, so the inner modifier was never installed. Animated Blood 573357 has DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms and summons creature 315301 through SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON, whose lifetime Spell::EffectSummonType takes from the spell duration after SPELLMOD_DURATION. With ten Thirst stacks the amalgam must therefore live 25000 ms instead of 15000 ms. The discriminating assertion is the amalgam still being alive 18 seconds after the cast: on today's tree it despawned at 15 seconds. The final assertion pins the upper end so the extension is exactly the ten seconds the record authorises, not an unbounded one.

steps.label: Past Animated Blood's own 15 s duration
Ten Thirst stacks keep the amalgam alive past 15 s
The amalgam despawns at the extended duration, not later
